name: Balsamic Grilled Chicken with Peach, Tomato & Basil Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 peaches
2 tomatoes
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Halve the tomatoes lengthwise and cut out and discard the stem ends; cut the halves into thin wedges. Transfer to a large salad bowl.
Quarter the peaches lengthwise (around the pit) and twist the quarters to separate, then remove and discard the pits; cut each quarter lengthwise into thin wedges. Add to the salad bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Trim off and discard the root end of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a medium bowl (that will be used to marinade the chicken).
To the garlic, add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk together.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat dry the chicken breasts with paper towels and place in the bowl with the marinade; turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Carefully place the chicken breasts in the grill pan / skillet; cook until the chicken is golden brown and cooked through (check doneness with a thermometer or cut into the chicken with a knife), 6 to 8 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chicken to plate.
Trim off and discard the ends of the shallot; peel and halve the shallot lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the salad bowl.

Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons. Add to the salad bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, then season with salt and pepper; gently toss until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp balsamic vinegar
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice the chicken crosswise into strips.
To serve, divide the salad and chicken slices between plates. Enjoy!
